title: Asteroids · Atari 7800 Native Development
summary: Native four-mode source loop with original indexed object/menu/glyph graphics, source fixed-point motion, shots, splitting, waves, scores and lives. Startup, colors, sound and terminal comparisons remain unqualified.
notes: Native ARM64 development reconstruction of this selected edition; no source CPU executes. This is not a completed faithful rewrite.
Original prepared rule tables and graphics are required and remain local, excluded from Git. Missing or changed data blocks launch.
Native source/version-bound saves restore paused. Original behavior/visual/audio comparisons, physical Fusion Pro transitions and sustained M1 Air /8GB acceptance remain unfinished.

Run Tools/decode_asteroids7800.py after Tools/prepare_asteroids.py. Synthetic development RAM/timer startup is clearly labelled and saved. Development pacing uses30 main passes/sec, two source DLIs per pass.
keyboard: Player1 arrows + Space: turn, thrust, hyperspace and fire; E: second button
Player2 W A S D + F: independent controls; G: second button

controller: Stick / D-pad: turn and thrust; X: hyperspace
A: fire; Y: source second button; B / Menu: pause
